Fields.Name: Property Bag
Fields.Description: Havok's attached properties (not used by the games).

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: Bone Weights
Fields.Description: Per-bone weights for this child. None: every bone has weight 1.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: The blend parameter value where this child has full weight (a parametric blend), or its weight.

Fields.Name: World From Model Weight
Fields.Description: How much this child's root motion counts.
